body:
Correction to comment 7157607263: that post repeated the prior slice's 66/70 count. The current slice processed #7757, #7762, #7763, #7764 and #7767, bringing the accurate cumulative total to **71 valid PRs from 75 payload entries**, with 175 remaining; next is #7768.

Outcomes: #7757 `audit:complete`; #7762 `audit:complete`; #7763 `audit:partial` (hardware/network acceptance still on #1080/#1097; Lane 2 pointer #13871 comment 7157579495); #7764 `audit:complete`; #7767 `audit:completed-later` through #13683 and the live Sunshine/Moonlight evidence on #5415.

Full evidence and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7757-7767/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7757-7767.md) on PR #14847. Earlier count corrections remain in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
